name: OBSdraw
description: A secure, collaborative drawing overlay for OBS Studio.

ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key used by editors to sign in.

VIEW_KEY.description: Read-only key embedded in the OBS browser-source URL.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs editor sessions. Keep this value private.

SOCKET_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs short-lived Socket.IO credentials. Keep this value private.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Trust Heroku's proxy headers for rate limiting and secure request handling.
